proposalAssessment.standing: Root one-file proposal read as a REFERENCE, not authority. I assess each boundary choice independently.
proposalAssessment.groupingKey: ACCEPT (snapshotId, relation, resolution, sourceUniverse, targetUniverse). It equals the relation registry file@enumerated matchOn and equals the tuple I already published in identity §3, so the enforced key and the stated key are the same object.
proposalAssessment.perViewIsolation: ACCEPT. partition_subjects is rebuilt per view, so cross-view reuse of one scope stays lawful. That is required: two views of one Run legitimately carry the same scope.
proposalAssessment.scopesWithoutCoverage: ACCEPT and important. Iterating view[scopeIds] covers scopes with no Coverage entry, which reach no other membership check; a Coverage-keyed loop would miss exactly the case a producer cannot see.
proposalAssessment.singleProducerLimit: ACCEPT. admit_coverage_result_v3 sees one scope and cannot decide a between-scopes property, so retained Run closure is the only correct boundary. No new host effect or protocol call is introduced.
proposalAssessment.placementDisagreement: DO NOT ADOPT AS PROPOSED. The proposal runs the overlap test BEFORE SCOPE_SOURCE_JOIN. I will run the per-scope well-formedness checks for every scope first and compute the partition afterwards, so a foreign-snapshot or unselected-enumerator scope refuses as ITSELF. This follows the codebase discipline already stated for the anchor law (a refusal at the wrong place is never counted as coverage of the intended one).
proposalAssessment.authorityDisagreement: The proposal hardcodes the tuple in identity-model. I will publish it as coveragePartitionLaw in the relation registry beside coverageTotalityLaw and have identity-model READ it, matching how coverageTotality and the ladder are already handled.
proposalAssessment.refusalNaming: Extend the proposal name with the offending relation@rung and subject, matching COVERAGE_INVENTORY_TOTALITY_OMITS_PATH. Internal AdmissionError only - no public detail code and no D9 change.
